What we sent you:
- Credit note: CreditNote_GreenFold_20261106.pdf (attached)
- Corrected invoice: Corrected_Invoice_GF-202610-001.pdf (attached)

Thanks again for the callout. If you want a short post-mortem on the connector retry root cause and our mitigation plan (we're adding a dedupe flag on retries), I can set up a 30-minute slot with our engineering ops team next week.
